title: Location Presence Weekly Travel Time Trend
dataSources: Life service health (`lifeos:service`), personal scorecards (`lifeos:score`), breach notifications (`hibp:breach`), location visits (`location:visit`), runbook checklists (`runbook:checklist`), and Home Assistant outage events (`homeassistant:event`).
app: Apple and Google location exports, Have I Been Pwned breach alerts, Todoist-style personal runbooks, and Home Assistant outage events streamed into Splunk HEC under `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=location:visit travel_minutes=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(travel_minutes) as avg_duration, max(travel_minutes) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst travel time for location presence events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture travel_minutes on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average travel time with markers for the worst week.

references.title: Have I Been Pwned API v3

grandmaExplanation: It reminds whether location presence tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
